verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and processing platform, so settlement and reconciliation reporting is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack shows no daily settlement files and no report API covering interchange, fees or network adjustments. The only nearby items are an Adjustments endpoint that delivers Reversal and Refund transactions and a monitoring Dashboard. Both are transaction-processing or UI features, not machine-readable reconciliation artifacts, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I get machine-readable reconciliation artifacts — daily settlement files or report APIs covering interchange, fees, and network adjustments — that my finance stack can consume automatically
